title: Crescent of the Twin Rivers: An Elite Glaive Syllabus
summary: Trains a Xiantian glaive fighter to run two separate streams of qi through the hands and join them in the cut.

title: Paired Moons Glaive Canon
summary: A canon of rising and falling crescent arcs, struck in pairs, that closes into a full circle of cuts.

title: The Azure Reach: Glaive Discourse of the Long Basin
summary: A discourse on stretching azure qi far beyond the steel, so the glaive cuts at distances the shaft cannot reach.

title: Hawk-Shadow Glaive Forms
summary: Uses the shadow of a high-held blade as a feint and a measure, then dives like a hawk in the cut.

title: Glaive Strategies of the Dual-Track Ford
summary: Teaches crossing an opponent's two tracks of footing like a ford of stones, breaking his stride with edge and shaft.

title: Silver Crescent and Blue Current Treatise
summary: Pairs the keen silver cut with the soft blue current of defence, moving through each attack as a river through reeds.

title: The Basin-Crowned Glaive: A High Syllabus
summary: Teaches a single glaive fighter to hold the centre of a ring of attackers and cut every side in turn.

title: Sworn Crescent of the Open Plateau
summary: A text of oath-bound stances and crescent cuts held as steadily as the stone of the plateau.

title: The Oath-Bearing Glaive: An Elite Syllabus
summary: Binds every cut, thrust and parry to a single bearing taken on the foe and sworn to the end.

title: Glaive Discourse of the Long Wind
summary: Teaches the glaive fighter to read the long wind and gather its weight into edge, sweep and reach.

title: Bearings Taken Along the Plateau Edge: Glaive Forms
summary: Teaches fighting along the rim of the plateau, turning every parry of the foe toward the drop.

title: Gale-Crescent Treatise of the Unwalled Country
summary: A treatise on running crescent cuts across open country with a gale of qi and no cover for the foe.

title: Wind-Sworn Reaping Glaive Canon
summary: A canon of long reaping cuts, laid row by row, that clears whole lines of foes with the glaive.

title: The Last Oath of the Long Blade
summary: Teaches the glaive fighter to keep one final oath through every stroke until the fight is done.
